text: Whatever the cupholder says
quip: Nice try. The cupholder has no authority here.

text: Ask the first car you see
quip: Nice try. Cars are great listeners and terrible at policy.

text: Wait until the 401 clears up
quip: Nice try. The 401 clears up the day pigs fly.

text: After one more coffee
quip: Nice try. The coffee can wait. The renter cannot.

text: Whatever the GPS says, turn left
quip: Nice try. The GPS is also wrong about that street.

text: Hide in the trunk until it passes
quip: Nice try. The trunk is for luggage, not for problems.

text: Honk three times and hope
quip: Nice try. Honking is not a process.

text: Blame the traffic on the Gardiner
quip: Nice try. Even the Gardiner is not an excuse for this one.

text: Ask the car how it feels
quip: Nice try. The car says it feels fine and wants its photos taken.

text: Put it in the glovebox for later
quip: Nice try. The glovebox is full of old napkins already.

text: Wash the car and hope nobody notices
quip: Nice try. A clean car still needs the right answer.

text: Leave a crayon note on the dashboard
quip: Nice try. The renter cannot read crayon at 100 km/h.

text: Refill the coffee, not the fuel
quip: Nice try. The car does not run on a double-double.

text: A large double-double, extra hot
quip: Nice try. Good order, wrong answer.

text: Whatever the renter's dog recommends
quip: Nice try. The dog is a good boy, not a policy.

text: Press every button until something works
quip: Nice try. That is how the wipers end up on in July.

text: Park it on the streetcar tracks
quip: Nice try. The streetcar disagrees, loudly.

text: Wait for the Gardiner repairs to finish
quip: Nice try. We would be waiting a very long time.

text: Send the car a text
quip: Nice try. The car left you on read.

text: Tell the renter the car is on a coffee break
quip: Nice try. Cars do not get breaks. Staff do.

text: Park with a nice view of the CN Tower
quip: Nice try. A great view is not a parking policy.

text: Count the parking tickets and call it a day
quip: Nice try. The tickets would like a word.

text: Roll down the windows and sing
quip: Nice try. Singing is lovely, but it does not close a booking.

text: Spin the steering wheel and see
quip: Nice try. The steering wheel only does left and right.

text: Ask the office plant
quip: Nice try. The plant is thriving but has no opinion.

text: Pull over for a snack first
quip: Nice try. Snacks are a great idea after the right answer.

text: Check the glovebox for the answer
quip: Nice try. It holds a manual, a pen and one mitten.

text: Switch the radio to a different station
quip: Nice try. The traffic report will not help here.

text: Flip a loonie
quip: Nice try. Loonies are for parking meters, not decisions.

text: Trade it for a bag of milk
quip: Nice try. Milk bags do not close bookings.

text: Wait for the snow to melt
quip: Nice try. This is Toronto. That is April, at the earliest.

text: Ask the squirrel on the hood
quip: Nice try. The squirrel left with your lunch.

text: Do it tomorrow, after the morning rush
quip: Nice try. The Toronto morning rush runs until about noon.

text: Let the steering wheel sign for it
quip: Nice try. The steering wheel has no signing authority.

text: Declare a coffee emergency
quip: Nice try. A real emergency still needs the real steps.

text: Put a sticker on it and move on
quip: Nice try. Stickers are not a workflow.

text: Wave at the renter from a safe distance
quip: Nice try. A friendly wave is nice, and not an answer.

text: Blame the winter tires
quip: Nice try. The winter tires have heard it all before.

text: Take the DVP and see what happens
quip: Nice try. On the DVP nothing happens, slowly.

text: Hit snooze on the dashboard
quip: Nice try. The dashboard has no snooze button.

text: Ask the air freshener
quip: Nice try. It only knows one scent and one answer.

text: Make a playlist about it first
quip: Nice try. Great playlist, still the wrong answer.

text: Hold a team meeting in the back seat
quip: Nice try. Seatbelts on, answers right.

text: Hope the renter forgets
quip: Nice try. Renters remember everything, especially the deposit.

text: Offer the renter a free coffee instead
quip: Nice try. Coffee is lovely, but it is not a fix.

text: Put on the hazards and hope
quip: Nice try. Hazards say there is a problem. They do not solve it.

text: Drive around the block until it works out
quip: Nice try. That is how you meet the same red light twice.

text: Call a friend who owns a minivan
quip: Nice try. The minivan is booked for hockey this weekend.

text: Sort it out at the next red light
quip: Nice try. In Toronto, that red light lasts a week.

text: Warm the car up for 40 minutes first
quip: Nice try. Idling is not a plan.

text: Scrape the windshield and hope for the best
quip: Nice try. A clear windshield still needs the right answer.

text: Say it in the voice of the GPS
quip: Nice try. In 200 metres, please choose the right answer.

text: Count the orange cones on the way in
quip: Nice try. Toronto has more cones than answers.

text: File it under snacks
quip: Nice try. The snack drawer is not an archive.

text: Tape a note to the visor
quip: Nice try. The visor falls down and the note falls with it.

text: Sign it with a smiley face
quip: Nice try. The smiley is friendly, but it is not legal.

text: Roll the dice, then roll again
quip: Nice try. Dice are for game night.

text: Politely ignore the problem
quip: Nice try. Problems are not shy. They come back.

text: Whatever the horn says
quip: Nice try. The horn only knows one word.

text: Wait for rush hour to end
quip: Nice try. It never ends. It only changes direction.

text: Ask the espresso machine
quip: Nice try. It is busy making the third coffee.

text: Take a long lunch first
quip: Nice try. Lunch comes after the quiz.

text: Ask the rear-view mirror
quip: Nice try. Objects in the mirror are closer than they appear, and no more helpful.

text: Let the cruise control decide
quip: Nice try. Cruise control only does one thing: cruise.

text: Park it beside the biggest pothole
quip: Nice try. Toronto has a pothole for every occasion.

text: Try turning it off and on again
quip: Nice try. That works for printers, not for rentals.

text: Check what the cup of coffee thinks
quip: Nice try. The coffee is cold and has no thoughts.

text: Hand over the keys and run
quip: Nice try. The keys stay with a person who has signed.

text: Put it on the other car's tab
quip: Nice try. The other car is not paying either.

text: Wrap the car in a big red bow
quip: Nice try. It looks great, and it is still the wrong answer.

text: Ask the tow truck for a second opinion
quip: Nice try. The tow truck always says the same thing: it is going to cost you.

text: Follow the car in front, whatever it does
quip: Nice try. The car in front is also lost.
